_doc: Sector -> tradeable expression map for market translation. Direction semantics: 'down' on rates = bond prices down / yields up. Analysis only — doctrine §14: no sizing.

energy.notes: crude/gas/services; chokepoint events transmit here first (Hormuz, Red Sea)

shipping.notes: tankers (FRO/STNG) vs containers (ZIM/MATX/GSL/DAC) vs drybulk (BDRY) respond to DIFFERENT chokepoints — match the corridor

rates.notes: duration proxies; direction=down means yields UP

fx.notes: UUP = dollar; captive-buyer currency stress per §10.8 redirection effect

ag_inputs.notes: §10.8 fertilizer cascade: phosphate/ammonia/urea -> food prices -> instability

airlines_aero.notes: §11.4: civil aviation is a Pax-dependent luxury; reprices fast under conflict

robotics.notes: physical AI / automation; main index BOTZ

space.notes: LEO / launch / satellite; main index ARKX

memory.notes: no pure-play memory ETF; SMH proxy. §13 scarcity-premium applies

chips.notes: broad semis; alias of 'semis'; main index SOXX

ai_datacenters.notes: neocloud + power + cooling; main index DTCR; power leg via GRID/uranium_power

hyperscalers.notes: definitionally mega-cap cloud; main index MAGS
